text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean professionals living and working in South Africa -- who has hitherto not been recognised as potential investors -- have taken the initiative to play a role in the growth of their country's economy.

- Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe says southern African leaders want to see their region succeed and will continue to co-operate in matters of mutual interest until there is complete regional peace and prosperity.
- Zimbabwe has scrapped visa requirements imposed on several countries which were set to take effect next January.
